answer: Sybil resistance follows from reputation scores that decay exponentially with a fixed half-life: identities must provide sustained, positively evaluated service to retain influence. In the EigenTrust graph, freshly spawned identities have few trusted incoming endorsements, so their eigenvector centrality is near zero. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot bootstrap isolated collusion into trusted mass, and such identities cannot pass consensus thresholds; names like sonnet, lagoon, or whisper confer no advantage.
